posts.title: Nvidia China Dealings are about to Explode
posts.description: The Investment World has been distracted by the Tech Bros calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement and Nvidia’s stellar numbers last night, but these might prove to be last hurrahs for the beleaguered firm. Nvidia sits at the nexus of the risk the AI bubble bursts, US-China competition and a financial crisis among AI funders, particularly in Private Credit. Nothing is quite what it seems.
